thread.title: Some Apple, FitBit Products to be Left Off New U.S. Tariff List -Bloomberg

author: morningstar.com
title: Some Apple, FitBit Products to be Left Off New U.S. Tariff List -Bloomberg
text:
--The latest round of tariffs to be announced by the White House will exclude several high-tech products, including some made by Apple Inc. (AAPL) and FitBit Inc. (FIT), Bloomberg reported Monday, citing "two people familiar with the matter."
--Products such as Apple's Watch and AirPods, as well as fitness trackers such as those made by FitBit, will not be included on the list of items which will have new tariffs imposed, the report said.
--President Trump is slated to make an announcement about tariffs after the close of the trading day at 4 p.m. EDT.
Full story: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-09-17/u-s-is-said-to-spare-some-apple-goods-from-latest-china-tariffs?srnd=premium
